[Chinese Main Title]: Fill in the subject
[English Title]: Fill in the English name
[Artistic Subject]: Characters / Flowers and Birds / Landscapes / Architecture, etc.
[Expression Medium]: Gongbi / Ink and Wash / Light Color / Photography Collage, etc.
[Text-Image Interaction]: Interspersing / Occlusion / Fusion / Cropping
[Color Palette]: Fill in primary and secondary colors
[Exhibition Information]: Date, Location, Institution, Theme phrase, Introduction
[Aspect Ratio]: 9:16

Create a complete Oriental Arts editorial exhibition poster, integrating traditional Chinese painting and calligraphy art, giant Chinese character calligraphy, modern font design, and professional art exhibition layout.

Use clean and warm ivory white Xuan paper, delicate brush and ink, natural mineral colors, and exquisite printing texture.

Use ultra-large Chinese characters as the main visual anchor, establishing visual tension through staggered vertical arrangement, size contrast, partial cropping, and asymmetrical composition.

Let the artistic subject and the Chinese characters have real spatial interaction, such as water sleeves passing through characters, flower branches obscuring strokes, mountains and seas fusing with calligraphy, and architectural paper fragments overlapping with text.

Design a complete Chinese and English exhibition information system, including titles, subtitles, exhibition dates, locations, theme phrases, curatorial introductions, and category tags.

Use a mix of Calligraphy, Songti, English Serif, and modern Sans-serif numerals, combined with fine grids, thin line separators, vertical and horizontal text, and local dense information to form a rich and orderly editorial design.

The overall style maintains the temperament of Oriental paper-based art, with a high-density subject and white space in the background; from a distance, it has a strong visual impact, and from up close, it has exquisite painting details and professional layout completion.

Independently innovate the composition based on the theme, do not mechanically replicate the same layout.

Single 9:16 vertical graphic poster, text is clear and accurate, no garbled characters, no meaningless placeholder text, no watermarks, no numbering, no four-pointed stars, no cheap template feel.
